Work.title: RECENT
Work.introDescription: Production systems built with performance and reliability in mind.
Work.project1Description: Large-scale inventory & stock management ERP with real-time Socket.io updates, tRPC APIs, Prisma ORM, AI integration, BullMQ job queues, Meilisearch, and PWA support.
Work.project1Details: Stock Tsika is a comprehensive inventory and stock management ERP system built to handle enterprise-scale operations. The application features real-time collaboration through Socket.io, allowing multiple users to track inventory changes simultaneously. The backend is powered by tRPC for end-to-end type-safe APIs, Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL for robust data modeling, and BullMQ with Redis for background job processing like report generation and stock alerts. AI integration via the Vercel AI SDK enables intelligent demand forecasting and automated reorder suggestions. Full-text search is handled by Meilisearch for instant product lookup across thousands of SKUs. The app includes barcode scanning, PDF generation for invoices, drag-and-drop workflows, rich text editing with Lexical, interactive charts with Recharts, and map-based warehouse visualization with Leaflet. Deployed as a PWA with offline support and Sentry monitoring in production.
Work.project2Description: Cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri and Rust backend, featuring real-time sync via Socket.io, barcode scanning, and offline-first architecture.
Work.project2Details: Desk Jim is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri, combining a Rust-powered backend with a React frontend for native-level performance. The app connects to a centralized server via Socket.io for real-time data synchronization across devices. It integrates Tauri plugins for barcode scanning, native file system access, HTTP requests, and SQLite for local data persistence. The state management layer uses Zustand for predictable client state, while TanStack Query handles server state and caching. The UI supports full internationalization via i18next and features a responsive design with Tailwind CSS. The Rust backend handles heavy computation and system-level operations, keeping the JavaScript thread free for smooth UI interactions.
Work.project3Description: Mobile learning app built with React Native and Expo, featuring SSE streaming, gesture-based navigation, and offline content caching.
Work.project3Details: Dev Lingo is a mobile-first learning application built with React Native and Expo Router for file-based navigation. The app streams AI-generated content using Server-Sent Events for a responsive, real-time learning experience. It uses TanStack Query for efficient data fetching and caching, Zustand for global state, and AsyncStorage for offline content persistence. The UI features gesture-based navigation with React Native Reanimated and Gesture Handler, haptic feedback via Expo Haptics, and optimized image loading with Expo Image. The app supports markdown rendering for rich lesson content and includes a splash screen, status bar customization, and deep linking via Expo Router.
Work.project4Description: Python automation system for intelligent data processing and workflow orchestration.
Work.project4Details: IGS is a Python-based automation system designed for intelligent data processing and workflow orchestration. The project handles data extraction, transformation, and automated pipeline execution, streamlining repetitive tasks into efficient, reproducible workflows.
Work.project5Description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform that digitizes the security operations daybook (main courante) for professional guarding companies — with a no-code WYSIWYG form builder, real-time SignalR notifications, validated reports and PDF export.
Work.project5Tags: .NET 8 • React 19 • SQL Server • Keycloak • SignalR • Azure
Work.project5Details: AVM OSGRIM (codename OSGRIMXV) is a full-stack electronic security-operations logbook that replaces paper main courante daybooks with a real-time, auditable, multi-tenant web application. Built on ASP.NET Core 8 with Clean Architecture and a React 19 + TypeScript SPA, it lets administrators design no-code data-entry forms in a WYSIWYG editor that are sanitized and re-hydrated into live React controls at runtime. It covers interventions, incidents, people and equipment movements, personnel shifts, first-aid assessments and training, secured by fine-grained multi-tenant RBAC (Partitions / Zones / Elements) and Keycloak OIDC, with real-time SignalR notifications, validated reports with full history, and PDF export. Deployed on Azure via Terraform with GitLab CI/CD.
